mapper.select: select report.report_id, report.form_id, report.service_code, report.patrol_record_code, report.report_file_id, if(`file`.filepath is null, '', report.report_file_name) as report_file_name, report.operator, if(report.operation_time is null, '', date_format(report.operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) as operation_time, `file`.filepath from om_report report left join s_file `file` on `file`.file_id = report.report_file_id and `file`.flag = 1 where report.patrol_record_code = #{patrolRecordCode}

select a.report_id, a.form_id, a.service_code, a.patrol_record_code, a.report_file_id, a.report_result, a.operator, DATE_FORMAT(a.operation_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS operation_time, b.filepath from om_report a LEFT JOIN s_file b ON b.file_id = a.report_file_id and b.flag = 1 where a.patrol_record_code = #{patrolRecordCode}
